title: Data Portability Revisited: Toward the Human-Centric, AI-Driven Data Ecosystems of Tomorrow
abstract: arXiv:2610.15503v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This Article critically examines the contemporary regulatory framework and discourse surrounding data portability in the United States. Using recent regulatory developments in the European Union as an illustration, this Article suggests that although data access and portability are identified as vital issues in multiple policy instruments, in its current iteration, at least, legal conceptions of portability continue to reinforce the interests of service providers and data controller enterprises rather than individual end users. This Article argues that a paradigm shift toward a more human-centric data approach to data governance must occur, under which data would be recognized as fundamental to an individual's identity in a digital age. Therefore, it should be placed in the hands of individuals rather than service providers or data controller enterprises. translated_title: 数据可携权再审视：迈向以人为中心、AI驱动的未来数据生态系统
translated_abstract: 本文批判性地审视了美国当前围绕数据可携权的监管框架与相关论述。以欧盟近期的监管发展为例证，本文指出，尽管数据访问与可携权已在多项政策文件中被确认为关键议题，但至少就其现行形态而言，可携权的法律概念仍在强化服务提供商和数据控制企业的利益，而非个人最终用户的利益。本文主张，数据治理必须发生范式转变，转向更加以人为中心的数据方法。在这一框架下，数据应被承认为数字时代个人身份的根本要素，因此数据应当掌握在个人手中，而非服务提供商或数据控制企业手中。本文进一步分析了欧盟的技术与市场趋势，这些趋势揭示了……
tldr: 本文批判性地指出美国现行数据可携权法律框架仍在服务企业利益而非个人用户，主张数据治理应转向以人为中心的范式，将数据视为数字时代个人身份的根本要素并交由个人掌控。
